import pandas as pd
import os

# Read input
input_path = 'outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(input_path)

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year if present)
id_columns = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']
indicator_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in id_columns]

# Compute missingness per indicator
missing_counts = {}
missing_rates = {}
kept_flags = {}

for col in indicator_columns:
    count = df[col].isna().sum()
    rate = count / len(df)
    missing_counts[col] = count
    missing_rates[col] = rate
    kept_flags[col] = rate <= 0.30

# Create missingness report
report_data = []
for col in indicator_columns:
    report_data.append({
        'indicator': col,
        'missing_count': missing_counts[col],
        'missing_rate': missing_rates[col],
        'kept': kept_flags[col]
    })

report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_data)
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False)

# Select columns with missing_rate <= 0.30
selected_indicators = [col for col in indicator_columns if missing_rates[col] <= 0.30]

# Create selected matrix
output_columns = ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + selected_indicators
selected_df = df[output_columns]

# Write selected matrix
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False)
</solution_file>
